items.value: Low Battery Where is the Power Outlet? It’s just within your arm’s reach. The ETL certified charging station of the small side table with storage can charge 4 devices simultaneously. 6.5 ft power supply cord also provides great convenience.

items.label: Safety Design
items.value: The outlets are designed on the left vertical side, safer to use. You don’t have to worry about electric shock caused by spilled drinks. Besides, the small end table living room and bedroom adopts the round corners and the edges are manufactured smooth to prevent injury.

items.label: Versatile End Table
items.value: The rustic narrow end table comes with a flip top drawer and 2-tier storage shelves offering ample space to storge and display where you can place your decorative lamps, drinks, phone, etc. This small bedside table is great for living room, bedroom and some small spaces.

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: With the simple structure and accessories marked with numbers, you can easily assemble the small nightstand with detailed instructions and tools. You can also assemble this couch table refer to the installation video on the product page. Any quality problem, assemble problem or missing parts please don't hesitate to contact us.

items.label: Fit in Small Spaces
items.value: This narrow side table with charging station takes up little space due to its compact design which makes it a perfect solution for small spaces and its excellent organize function makes it can also work as a great night stand for your bedroom.

items.label: Quality You Can Trust
items.value: Yoobure slim end table with storage is composed of durable particle board and sturdy steel frame to provide long-lasting durability and sturdiness, supporting up to 100 lbs for table top. And the bearing capacity of each shelf is 20 lbs.

items.label: NOTE
items.value: In order not to affect the storage space, the outlets, the hole for cable and the fixed half top should be installed on the same side.
